gappers.catalyst_detail: Satellogic appointed Frank D. "Trey" Whitworth -- a former Director of the NGA -- as company President, effective immediately, per coverage roughly 22 hours old at scan time. This follows an Aug 13 hire of Jamil Kawar as SVP Space Systems and an Aug 25 note on five-city investor meetings ahead of Space Week -- a pattern of building out government/defense-relations bench strength.

Likely explanations: the news is ~1-2 sessions old and already priced in, broader Aerospace & Defense softness, or profit-taking after a big run (52-wk range $1.25-$12.00, RSI 50, short interest an elevated 16.28%). Volume (39,730) is a small fraction of the 6.31M average, so the print may not reflect strong conviction either way.

gappers.catalyst: Meta officially launched Muse, its first personal AI agent, on Sept 8, 2026.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Meta launched Muse on Sept 8, 2026: a personal AI agent running on a "Secure VM" gated by a "Sentinel" permission layer, with a free limited tier plus $20 and $100/month paid tiers. Functions include sending emails/messages, booking travel, and making purchases/payments -- broad account and agentic access, which multiple outlets flagged as a trust/privacy question given the scope requested (email, calendar, payments, health services).
gappers.why: A first-party personal AI agent with payment and calendar access is a genuine new product category for Meta beyond chatbots, read by the market as expanding Meta's AI monetization surface (subscription tiers) and competitive position vs. OpenAI/Google agent products -- pulling in momentum buyers on real volume.
